rootCause: The density gate recognized editorial grounding labels but did not compare generated prose with the supplied user facts.

implementation.behavior: Existing lexical evidence remains valid. The additive path accepts only multiple meaningful tokens reused within one explicitly approved user-entered context field.
implementation.minimumBoundary: At least three shared meaningful tokens, or at least two with one token of three or more characters.
